hero.pitch: Write, simulate and deploy Signum smart contracts — entirely in your browser. Nothing to install.

write.title: Write
write.blurb: SmartC editor with completion, hover docs and live compiler diagnostics.

test.title: Test
test.blurb: Write tests beside your contract and run them in the browser, with values inline.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.blurb: Step through against a scenario: breakpoints, variables, a mock ledger.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.blurb: Connect your wallet and publish to Signum testnet or mainnet.

smartc-repo.title: SmartC language & compiler
smartc-repo.blurb: Syntax reference, built-in functions and the compiler itself.

signum-docs.title: Signum documentation
signum-docs.blurb: How the Signum network, accounts and transactions work.

signum-network.title: Signum network
signum-network.blurb: The project, its ecosystem and community.

smallScreen.title: Best on a larger screen
smallScreen.body: SmartC Studio is built for desktop use. On small screens the editor, simulator and deployment views won't have enough room — please switch to a laptop or desktop.
